raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stacked on #46228 (Wan q/k RMSNorm + RoPE fusion); review the commits after it.

## Motivation

Each Wan block projects the same normalized hidden states three times (to_q, to_k, to_v; at 720p on 4xB300 three [37800, 5120] x [5120, 5120] GEMMs per block per rank). One [37800, 5120] x [5120, 15360] GEMM reads the input once and runs with fewer tile-wave tails.

## Modifications

`models/dits/wanvideo.py`:
- `WanTransformerBlock.fuse_qkv_weights()` concatenates the three unquantized projection weights and biases into one `[3 * dim, dim]` / `[3 * dim]` buffer and rebinds each layer's parameters as views of its rows, so the parameters, the state dict and in-place weight updates keep working and no memory is added.
- The block keeps no reference to the shared buffer. `_fused_qkv(device)` reads it back from the three layers per call, as views over their storage (`_rows_of_one_buffer`), while they are still consecutive rows of one buffer on the input's device. Only the layers hold the buffer, so moving the module (component residency swapping an A14B expert, `--dit-cpu-offload`), layerwise offload or a weight swap frees it, and the block falls back to the three projections. A LoRA wrapper also turns the fused path off. The check costs ~10 us of host time per block call (4.4 us for the earlier stored-reference version) and is skipped under compile.
- `_qkv_rope` runs one `apply_unquantized_linear` over the shared weight and splits q/k/v as strided views (the fused q/k norm-rope, the Ulysses exchange and attention all take a token stride).
- `WanTransformer3DModel.post_load_weights` fuses every `WanTransformerBlock` and logs how many.

## Accuracy Tests

- `test_model_fast_paths.py::test_wan_fused_qkv_keeps_bits_and_frees_with_its_layers` (new Wan section, whose `_wan_block_env` / `_wan_block` / `_wan_block_inputs` helpers the later Wan PRs reuse): a Wan block (5120, 40 heads) gives the same bits before and after `fuse_qkv_weights`, and the layers' weights are unchanged. A weight moved out of the shared buffer turns the fused GEMM off (still the same bits). `block.to("cpu")` frees every byte the block held on the GPU, the shared buffer included; a version that keeps the buffer referenced fails this check. Re-fusing on CPU gives the concatenated weights, and moving back without re-fusing runs three GEMMs. Re-fusing on GPU runs the fused GEMM again, and every step gives the same bits.
- Wan2.2 T2V A14B 720p, 4xB300, 3-step lossless (crf 0) mp4: md5 identical to the build without the Wan stack for 3 prompts, also after the memory-lifetime fix.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

B300, `[37800, 5120] x [5120, N]` bf16 + bias, each GEMM repeated at the power cap (median): one N = 15360 GEMM 3.976 ms against three N = 5120 GEMMs 3 x 1.354 = 4.062 ms (cuBLAS picks the same `nvjet_sm103_tst_128x256_64x6_2x1_2cta` kernel; outputs bitwise equal). E2E (Wan2.2 T2V A14B 720p, 4xB300, harness single_e2e (fresh server per run, runs interleaved with the other arms)): base (fused q/k norm-RoPE stack) 90.160 / 90.214 s (mean 90.187) -> 90.034 / 90.105 / 90.143 s (mean 90.094), -0.09 s (-0.10%).

+def _rows_of_one_buffer(parts: list[torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """``torch.cat(parts)`` without a copy, when the parts are consecutive equal-shape
+    rows of one buffer"""
+    first = parts[0]
+    start, nbytes = first.data_ptr(), first.nbytes
+    storage = first.untyped_storage()
+    if start + len(parts) * nbytes > storage.data_ptr() + storage.nbytes():
+        return None
+    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
+        if (
+            part.data_ptr() != start + i * nbytes
+            or part.shape != first.shape
+            or not part.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            return None
+    return first.as_strided(
+        (len(parts) * first.shape[0], *first.shape[1:]), first.stride()
+    )
+
+

@@ -610,6 +632,51 @@ def __init__(
         self.mlp_residual = MulAdd()
 
         self.scale_shift_table = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 6, dim) / dim**0.5)
+        # set by fuse_qkv_weights: to_q / to_k / to_v are plain unquantized linears
+        self.qkv_fusable = False
+
+    def fuse_qkv_weights(self) -> None:
+        """Move to_q / to_k / to_v into consecutive rows of one weight and one bias, so a
+        single GEMM projects all three (``_fused_qkv``)"""
+        layers = (self.to_q, self.to_k, self.to_v)
+        self.qkv_fusable = all(
+            type(layer) is ColumnParallelLinear
+            and isinstance(layer.quant_method, UnquantizedLinearMethod)
+            and layer.bias is not None
+            and not layer.skip_bias_add
+            and not layer.gather_output
+            for layer in layers
+        )
+        if not self.qkv_fusable:
+            return
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            weight = torch.cat([layer.weight for layer in layers])
+            bias = torch.cat([layer.bias for layer in layers])
+        rows = self.to_q.weight.shape[0]
+        for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            layer.weight.data = weight[i * rows : (i + 1) * rows]
+            layer.bias.data = bias[i * rows : (i + 1) * rows]
+
+    def _fused_qkv(
+        self, device: torch.device
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None:
+        """The [3 * dim, dim] weight and [3 * dim] bias of ``fuse_qkv_weights``, read back
+        from the layers while they still share them on ``device``. Only the layers hold
+        the shared buffers, so moving the module or offloading or swapping a layer's
+        weight frees them."""
+        layers = (self.to_q, self.to_k, self.to_v)
+        if (
+            not self.qkv_fusable
+            or torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+            or not all(type(layer) is ColumnParallelLinear for layer in layers)
+            or self.to_q.weight.device != device
+        ):
+            return None
+        weight = _rows_of_one_buffer([layer.weight for layer in layers])
+        bias = _rows_of_one_buffer([layer.bias for layer in layers])
+        if weight is None or bias is None:
+            return None
+        return weight, bias

         assert not moss_image._RMSNORM_FUSION.disabled
 
 
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Wan -- fused q/k/v GEMM, FFN residual chain, text K/V once per loop
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _wan_block_env():
+    """Single-rank model parallel state and the attention patches a Wan block
+    needs to be built and run outside a pipeline."""
+    if not model_parallel_is_initialized():
+        ensure_distributed_env_defaults()
+        maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel(tp_size=1, sp_size=1)
+    with ExitStack() as stack:
+        for name, value in (
+            ("get_attn_backend", sdpa_backend.SDPABackend),
+            ("get_compute_dtype", torch.bfloat16),
+            ("_resolve_sp_attention_mode", ("ulysses", False)),
+            ("_maybe_install_backend_autotune", None),
+        ):
+            stack.enter_context(patch.object(attn_layer, name, return_value=value))
+        stack.enter_context(set_forward_context(0, None))
+        yield
+
+
+def _wan_block(dim=5120, heads=40):
+    block = WanTransformerBlock(
+        dim,
+        1024,
+        heads,
+        qk_norm="rms_norm_across_heads",
+        cross_attn_norm=True,
+        eps=1e-6,
+        supported_attention_backends=set(),
+    ).cuda()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for p in block.parameters():
+            p.normal_(0, 0.02)
+    return block.to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _wan_block_inputs(seq=512, dim=5120):
+    """x, (context, temb, freqs) as the block's positional args, and the
+    rope cos/sin cache"""
+    x = torch.randn(1, seq, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    context = torch.randn(1, 64, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    temb = torch.randn(1, 6, dim, device="cuda")
+    theta = torch.rand(seq, 64, device="cuda") * 50
+    freqs = (theta.cos(), theta.sin())
+    return x, (context, temb, freqs), torch.cat(freqs, dim=-1).contiguous()
+
+
+def _bits(x):
+    return x.view(torch.int16)
+
+
+@requires_inline_ptx
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_wan_fused_qkv_keeps_bits_and_frees_with_its_layers():
+    """q/k/v share one weight after loading and run as one GEMM with the same
+    bits; a layer that stops reading the shared weight sends the block back to
+    its three projections, and moving the block takes the shared weight along."""
+    with _wan_block_env():
+        block = _wan_block()
+        x, args, cache = _wan_block_inputs()
+        run = lambda: _bits(block(x, *args, rope_cos_sin_cache=cache))
+        projs = (block.to_q, block.to_k, block.to_v)
+        weights = [proj.weight.clone() for proj in projs]
+        ref = run()
+        assert block._fused_qkv(x.device) is None
+        block.fuse_qkv_weights()
+        assert block._fused_qkv(x.device) is not None
+        for proj, w in zip(projs, weights):
+            assert torch.equal(proj.weight, w)
+        assert torch.equal(run(), ref)
+
+        # a layer whose weight moved (offload, a weight swap) stops the fused GEMM
+        block.to_k.weight.data = block.to_k.weight.data.clone()
+        assert block._fused_qkv(x.device) is None
+        assert torch.equal(run(), ref)
+
+        # moving the block takes the shared weight with it: nothing else holds it
+        block.fuse_qkv_weights()
+        on_gpu = [*block.parameters(), *block.buffers()]
+        gpu_bytes = sum(t.numel() * t.element_size() for t in on_gpu)
+        del on_gpu
+        allocated = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
+        block.to("cpu")
+        assert allocated - torch.cuda.memory_allocated() >= gpu_bytes
+        assert block._fused_qkv(torch.device("cpu")) is None
+        block.fuse_qkv_weights()
+        fused_weight, fused_bias = block._fused_qkv(torch.device("cpu"))
+        assert torch.equal(fused_weight, torch.cat(weights).cpu())
+        assert torch.equal(fused_bias, torch.cat([p.bias for p in projs]))
+
+        block.to("cuda")
+        assert block._fused_qkv(x.device) is None
+        assert torch.equal(run(), ref)
+        block.fuse_qkv_weights()
+        assert block._fused_qkv(x.device) is not None
+        assert torch.equal(run(), ref)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
